_note: Poses may be authored in world space, or anchored. anchor:'player' treats pos/target as offsets from the hero on the ground plane. anchor:'rig' reproduces the LIVE camera rig geometry from entities/camera.js CAM_TUNING (pitch/yaw/distance/fov/lookHeight) so a shot IS the play camera rather than an approximation of it; every field is individually overridable, and `at` pins the orbit centre to a world point instead of the player. The old world-space poses aimed every 'gameplay' framing at the arena origin while the hero stood somewhere else, so the critic loop never actually looked at the subject. | FRAMING (round-2 fix): the wide pose was cropping the colonnade on all four edges at distance 30 / fov 34 / pitch 42, so the sizzle frame had no negative space at all and the outer columns raked like a fisheye diorama (ART_DIRECTION 1.8 wants an island of light in a dark void). 44 / 30 / 48 buys ~25% void margin on every edge and flattens the rake. The floor pose sat at fov 46 / pitch 16, outside 8's 34-40 band, so the 'floor test' was shot on a lens the game never uses; it is now a legal play lens. The detail pose looked at 3.6m on a 7.5m colonnade, which is why not one column capital appeared in any frame. | Round-2 second pass: distance 44 / pitch 48 bought the void margin but collapsed depthBands.spread to 0.131 (everything 44m away lands in one value band) — 37 / 44 / fov 32 keeps ~15% void on every edge AND keeps the near floor, the arena and the far wall in three separate thirds of the frame. The detail pose at pitch 20 / lookHeight 5.2 framed the capitals but pushed the floor out of the bottom of frame entirely, so the analyzer's ground sample was reading lit wall and groundVsFrame went to 1.15; pitch 27 / lookHeight 4.4 holds both. | ROUND-2 (AGENT-FIXER): 02/07/09/10 shipped as four byte-identical frames of the same empty arena from the same pose, with metrics matching to three decimals — four of ten shots were padding and a reviewer stopped the meeting there. 07 now uses a combat push-in framing (the player controller freezes a mid-combo attack pose for the 'combat' state; there is still no enemy cast because src/entities/enemies/index.js is an 8-line stub that returns null, which is AGENT-ENEMY's to ship). 09 uses a wider HUD-safe framing (src/ui/index.js is also a stub, so no HUD renders yet). 10 now looks at the GATE — the reward sigils burning over the doorways are the game's world-space boon advertisement and they are real, shipped geometry, which is a truthful boon frame even before AGENT-UI's boon cards exist. | The floor pose was shot at yaw 72 straight down at the ground with no rim, no lip and no void edge anywhere in frame, so §1.8's 'island of light in a dark void' could not be judged from it at all and the tiling test passed because there was nothing on the surface to repeat. It now sits over the near apron on the play yaw with the curb and the abyss in the upper third.
